decisions.title: Quick Tasting Notes-Based Flow
decisions.decision: Replace flavor selection with notes input (aroma, flavor, other); allow either notes OR selected flavors; map 0-100 score to 1-10 rating

decisions.title: Review Modes (Quick vs Prose)
decisions.decision: Add tabs for Quick Review (stars + sliders) vs Prose Review (title + content); shared base metadata

decisions.title: Constitutional Layer Implementation
decisions.decision: Enforce design system rules via ESLint; no raw HTML forms, no inline styles, no hardcoded colors; Prettier for formatting

decisions.title: API Schema Alignment
decisions.decision: Remove unsupported fields from API payload; use tasting_data jsonb for quick tasting data; maintain database compatibility

decisions.title: Design System Token Enforcement
decisions.decision: ESLint rules prevent hardcoded colors/RGB/HSL; ban raw form elements; require fx-* semantic tokens
